prohibited_inferences: Do not treat this synthetic fixture as evidence about Electric Twin, News UK, Dentsu, or any named deployment.
Do not infer manipulative intent from exposure confounding.
Do not treat an unexposed option as rejected.
Do not treat raw engagement share as population preference.
Do not treat propensity correction as proof that all real-world confounding is resolved.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A deterministic synthetic control showing that asymmetric exposure can change observed engagement shares while latent preferences remain fixed.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real deployment finding, a causal estimate for a named company, evidence of preference manipulation, or evidence of intent.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: This fixture proves only a mathematical identification problem: observations produced under unequal exposure cannot be interpreted as population preference without preserving the exposure policy and a valid counterfactual design.
